sw_dec_7702: You are authorizing code to act for your account (EIP-7702). A drainer can use this to take control. Approve only if you started this.
sw_dec_7702_known: Danger: this delegate is a known wallet drainer ($1). Do not sign.
sw_dec_order: You are signing an order that lets a marketplace (Seaport/Blur) move your NFTs or tokens. Only sign on a site you trust.
sw_find_all_l1: This lets $1 move every token you hold in the collection at $2, now and in the future.
sw_find_all_l2: Real marketplaces do ask for this, but a wrong address can empty the whole collection.
sw_find_all_title: Access to all of your tokens in a collection
sw_find_ethsign_warn: eth_sign can sign data that works like a transaction. Most sites never need it.
sw_find_lim_l1: This lets $1 spend up to $2 base units of the token at $3.
sw_find_lim_l2: The spender can use this amount without asking you again.
sw_find_permit_l1: Signing this gives $1 permission to spend your tokens. It costs no gas and nothing shows on-chain until it is used.
sw_find_permit_l1_unl: Signing this gives $1 permission to spend your tokens, with no practical limit. It costs no gas and nothing shows on-chain until it is used.
sw_find_permit_l2: A signed permit can be used later by whoever holds it, so only sign it for a site you trust.
sw_find_raw_blind: This signs data you cannot read. Only sign it if you started this action yourself.
sw_find_raw_text: This signs a text message. Read it before you confirm.
sw_find_unl_l1: This lets $1 spend as much as it wants of the token at $2, up to your whole balance.
sw_find_unl_l2: The limit is the largest number possible, so it never runs out.
sw_hl_agent: This gives another key ($1) permission to trade your Hyperliquid account. Only approve a key you created yourself.
sw_hl_builder: This lets $1 charge up to $2 in fees on your Hyperliquid trades.
sw_hl_l1: This is a Hyperliquid trading action that Signward cannot read. It can place orders or move vault funds. Only continue if you started it on the official app.
sw_hl_multisig: This hands control of your Hyperliquid account to other signers.
sw_hl_other: Hyperliquid action: $1. Only continue if you started it on the official app.
sw_hl_send: This sends $1 $2 from your Hyperliquid account to $3.
sw_hl_title: Hyperliquid signature on an unofficial site
sw_hl_usdsend: This sends $1 USDC from your Hyperliquid account to $2.
sw_hl_withdraw: This withdraws $1 USDC from Hyperliquid to $2.
sw_hl_wrong_site: This is not an official Hyperliquid app. Funds on Hyperliquid move with signatures like this one, and nothing shows on-chain until they are gone.
